issues.problem: explain and のに contrast claimed only のに works with 使う; 紙を切るには、はさみを使います is natural. The real rule is about saying what a thing is used for (X は ～のに使う).
issues.action: Reworded explain, contrast and mistake note to the 'what a thing is used for' rule; added the natural には + 使う advice case.

issues.problem: Example English 'the bus is the easiest way' mistranslates 便利.
issues.action: Changed to 'the bus is the most convenient'.

issues.problem: Intro used a filler metaphor ('between tweezers').
issues.action: Replaced with plain wording: quotes a word or a fact.

issues.problem: explain and mistake note said a definition must end in a noun; ～を意味する / ～を指す are verb endings and correct.
issues.action: Reworded to 'say what X is or means' and added ～を指す.

issues.problem: 'In the class' unnatural for クラスでは.
Intro said が and を never stack; をも exists in formal written Japanese.
double-particles explain implied plain は can never stand in for a case particle; に of time and of place with ある/いる often drops (日曜日は, この町は駅が二つある).
issues.action: Replaced the time-word paragraph with this exception and said と, から, まで, へ must stay.

issues.problem: double-particles tip was muddled ('still means the same').
no-compound rule, pattern, にの contrast and tip said に becomes への; followed mechanically gives ×七時への電車 (should be 七時の電車).
issues.action: Restricted への to a destination or recipient に; added that a time に becomes plain の in rule, explain, pattern, contrast and tip.

issues.problem: no-compound explain glossed 日本での生活 as 'my life in Japan'.
